meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: Repo deals between banks and other market players secured on government securities, week by week since April 1998: amounts, rate ranges and tenors, by kind of security
meta.note: RBI, Secondary Market Repo Transactions in Government Securities (Face Value) (DBIE report 267; also 769). Amounts converted from rupees to ₹ crore. Excludes the RBI's own repo operations.
